name: aicontentdrop
description: Make AI videos, images, finished ads and short dramas from a description, across multiple leading models. Browse the catalogue and cost estimates with no credential; generate with an API key or an OAuth sign-in.

interface.shortDescription: Make AI videos, images, ads and short dramas
interface.longDescription: Describe the video, image, ad or short drama you want. AI Content Drop picks a suitable model from multiple leading image and video engines, tells you the cost before anything runs, generates it, and returns the result here. It can also cut a finished, captioned ad from a brief, lay out a campaign on a board, research the ads competitors run, and write and produce a short vertical drama. Sign in with OAuth or an API key to generate; browsing models and cost estimates needs no account.
capabilities: Make a video ad or product video from a written description
Turn a product photo or still image into a short video clip
Make a thumbnail, poster, product still or concept image
Pick a suitable AI video or image model for the job and see the cost before anything runs
Turn a brief or script into a prompt the model will follow
Plan a storyboard or shot list and price the whole run first
Explain what a generation costs and whether it fits a credit balance
Make a finished, captioned video ad or UGC-style clip from a brief
Plan a campaign on a visual board and render its cards one approval at a time
Research the ads competitors run and decode a winner into a reusable brief
Write a short vertical drama and render and cut its episodes
Hand a whole campaign to the video agent and approve each paid step
defaultPrompt: Make a 5-second vertical video of a matcha latte being poured, product-ad style
Turn this product photo into a short cinematic clip
Which AI video model should I use for a 20-shot storyboard, and what will it cost?
